integrity: The theorem is derived from time-translation invariance and exact algebra. The conditional-regression step is proved directly; the rational defect and variance expansion are replayed by the bundled checker. No numerical experiment is used as proof.
limitations: Conditional on a compact shift-invariant law on bounded complete strictly positive solutions; does not prove existence, uniqueness, ergodicity, mixing, or chaos. Literature coverage is extensive but not exhaustive.
title: Exact size-biased equilibrium defect and activity budget in the Mackey–Glass equation
